topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: The silence stretches long after the news. My room, once a sanctuary of solitude, now holds the weight of countless unspoken words. The paper, once my private thoughts woven into sentences, now flutters in the hands of strangers. It's strange, to see the inner workings of your mind laid bare, open for all to see. Each word, a part of me, now adrift. The walls feel closer, the air a little thinner. The night presses in, heavy, as I ponder the boundaries between sharing and losing a piece of oneself.
